messages:
kevin: FYI product just greenlit a v1->v2 migration pilot. they want minimal customer friction but need predictable quota behavior. can we sketch a plan here?
marie: key ask from product: no surprise invoices. we need a conservative default mapping and a way for customers to opt into the new token model early.
sam: agree. propose 'migration_preview' flag that routes a copy for billing simulation only. full traffic unaffected. console can show the preview estimate.
ravi: technical: v2 counts function-call payloads differently and charges per-declared-output-token. mapping isn't 1:1. we should provide a safe upper-bound multiplier for automatic migration to avoid undercharging.
ops-sre: rollout constraint: don't enable migration_preview for >5% tenants simultaneously in a region. keep a global throttle. also ensure we can stop previews quickly if we see spike.
console-team: UI idea: two toggles per-project: "Preview cost impact" and "Auto-accept migration when within X%". preview shows breakdown by route + sample queries.
kevin: good. on the mapping algorithm, could we run a sampling job that takes a week's v1 traffic and computes estimated v2 cost? then store per-tenant multiplier.
marie: yes sampling sounds perfect. need a storage limit though. maybe keep only last 30 days of sampling windows.
sam: implementation note: sampling job should be idempotent and safe. sketch for mapping calc: ```
// pseudo
for each tenant:
  sampled_requests = fetch_v1_samples(tenant)
  v2_estimate = run_v2_simulator(sampled_requests)
  multiplier = max(1.0, v2_estimate.tokens / v1.tokens)
  store_multiplier(tenant, multiplier)
```
ravi: edge cases: short-lived tenants with few samples -> use global default multiplier (recommend 1.25). also handle function-heavy tenants separately (use 1.6).
ops-sre: monitoring: emit metric migration_preview_error_rate and preview_cost_ratio percentiles. set alert if median ratio > 2.0 or error rate > 0.3%.
\e2: (typo) meant kevin: we also need an audit log event for when console flips preview/auto-accept toggles. tie to migration_id and user_id.
console-team: will add an activity feed entry and a migration timeline UI so customers can see when their preview started.
kevin: billing: legal wants to be careful. recommend adding a "cost-preview" disclaimer and require a confirmation modal for Auto-accept migration. console-team, add copy.
marie: migration windows: product suggests a 6-week open preview then a 2-week mandatory migration for tenants who opted in; others get banner + scheduled migration unless they request extension.
sam: for forced migrations we must implement a soft-smoothing step: when switching, gradually apply tenant_multiplier over 24h in 10% increments to avoid billing cliffs.
ravi: technical switch plan: 1) preview_simulator service 2) per-tenant multiplier store 3) migration controller that signals routing layer to flip headers 4) soft-smoothing agent that rewrites recorded token counts for billing during transition.
ops-sre: runbook: include rollback steps to clear preview flags, pause smoothing agent, and revert routing header emitter. target RTO < 10m.
console-team: copy for banner: "We're moving /v1 to /v2. Preview your estimated cost changes in the Migration panel. Contact support to delay." (will iterate with legal)
kevin: telemetry: emit migration_state{preview|smoothing|completed}, estimate_delta_pct, and sample_top_queries for top 5 routes. keep tags: tenant_id, region, migration_id.
marie: action items: sam -> sampling job + simulator endpoint; ravi -> multiplier store + smoothing agent; console-team -> UI toggles + modal copy; ops-sre -> runbook + throttles; kevin -> coord with billing/legal.
deploy-bot: note: sampling job scheduled to run weekly in staging on 2025-09-18; will promote to prod after QA.
kevin: pinging @sam @ravi @ops-sre to confirm owner assignments.
sam: ack, I'll open the PR for simulator endpoint tomorrow.
ravi: ack, I'll prototype the smoothing agent and share perf implications.
ops-sre: will draft runbook and the throttling guardrails; will circulate for review.
marie: thanks team. let's keep console copy short and ensure preview is easy to find. we'll bring a draft to the product sync on Friday. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks, closing thread for now. will post updates as tasks land.
